name: kwin-mcp
description: KDE Plasma 6 Wayland GUI automation MCP server (kwin-mcp). Plugin scaffold only: no MCP endpoint is declared until an authorized remote route and auth contract exist. See docs/codex-plugin.md.

interface.shortDescription: KDE Plasma 6 Wayland GUI automation over MCP
interface.longDescription: kwin-mcp drives an isolated KDE Plasma 6 Wayland session: session_start/session_stop, launch_app, screenshot, window_list, window_activate, accessibility_tree, find_ui_elements, mouse_click/move/scroll/drag, keyboard_type/key. This plugin currently ships metadata only. The server speaks MCP over stdio, and no authorized HTTPS route or authentication contract for a remote endpoint exists yet, so mcpServers is intentionally omitted rather than pointing at a URL that returns 404. docs/codex-plugin.md records the required route/auth contract and the observed blocker.
